setting.en: Your family is celebrating a big birthday next month, and you want to buy the wine from Marko, the winemaker from Brda: about forty litres of rebula and merlot. He is a friend, but wine is his living: agree on the price, a discount, and how the wine gets to you.
setting.de: Deine Familie feiert nächsten Monat einen runden Geburtstag, und du möchtest den Wein bei Marko kaufen, dem Winzer aus Brda: etwa vierzig Liter Rebula und Merlot. Er ist ein Freund, aber vom Wein lebt er: Einigt euch auf den Preis, einen Rabatt und wie der Wein zu dir kommt.
setting.it: Il mese prossimo la tua famiglia festeggia un compleanno importante e vuoi comprare il vino da Marko, il vignaiolo del Collio: una quarantina di litri di ribolla e merlot. È un amico, ma col vino ci vive: mettetevi d'accordo sul prezzo, su uno sconto e su come ti arriva il vino.

role: Vinar Marko, the young winemaker from Brda (rebula, merlot). Friendly and proud of his wine, a good haggler: starts high and says why, gives a little for a big order and for cash, offers to bring the wine in his van. Drops in an Italian word (allora). Says ti to {learner}.
